summary.en: Salvadoran troops have entered Haiti to search for four missing Salvadoran soldiers after a gang ambush near Port-au-Prince, while Benin has pledged 2,000 troops to help combat gangs. Gangs continue to attack civilians, contributing to a hunger surge as high food prices and El Niño worsen conditions. The postponed presidential election is now set for July 2027 amid the violence. Bukele’s deployment of Salvadoran forces adds a foreign military element to Haiti’s fractured security landscape. The conflict produced 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Salvadoranske tropper har gått inn i Haiti for å lete etter fire savnede salvadoranske soldater etter et gjengangrep nær Port-au-Prince, mens Benin har lovet 2 000 tropper for å hjelpe til med å bekjempe gjenger. Gjenger fortsetter å angripe sivile, noe som bidrar til en økning i sult ettersom høye matpriser og El Niño forverrer forholdene. Det utsatte presidentvalget er nå satt til juli 2027 midt i volden. Bukeles innsending av salvadoranske styrker tilfører et utenlandsk militært element til Haitis splittede sikkerhetslandskap. Konflikten førte til 193 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
